topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I stepped into what I thought would be a room filled with shouts of surprise and laughter, instead finding an empty space, decorated with forgotten balloons and creased banners. The news, a whisper of a cancelled celebration, found its way to my ears, and I wondered what could have changed so swiftly. Yet, in the quiet, I found a different gift, a quieter one. The thought of rearranging this evening, not with guests and noise, but with books and candlelight, feels unexpectedly right. There’s a kindness in the solitude, a chance to relish the moment without the rush of applause. Tonight, I’ll create my own warmth in this vast, still room.
